seo.title: 5-Day Morocco Imperial Cities Tour from Casablanca | Chefchaouen & Fes (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €490 pp. 5-day private cultural tour from Casablanca to Fes. Visit Hassan II Mosque, Rabat, Chefchaouen blue medina, Roman Volubilis & medieval Fes.
seo.lead: This five-day itinerary focuses on Morocco's history, architecture, and coastal cities without long desert drives. Starting in Casablanca at the Hassan II Mosque, you follow the Atlantic coast to Rabat to explore the Kasbah of the Udayas and the 12th-century Hassan Tower.

price.label: From EUR 490 per person
price.note: Includes private A/C vehicle with driver-guide, 4 nights in boutique riads/hotels (Casablanca, Chefchaouen, and 2 nights in Fes), a full-day licensed guide in Fes, airport transfers, and daily breakfasts from Day 2.

seo.imageAlt: Blue-painted steps and doorways of Chefchaouen medina during a 5-day northern Morocco imperial cities tour from Casablanca
highlights: Visit the oceanfront Hassan II Mosque in Casablanca
Explore the Kasbah of the Udayas and Mohammed V Mausoleum in Rabat
Wander the blue-painted medina and mountain viewpoints of Chefchaouen
Walk among the Roman mosaics and triumphal arch at UNESCO-listed Volubilis
See the 18th-century Bab Mansour gate in imperial Meknes
Full-day guided walking tour inside the medieval medina of Fes

faqs.question: Is this trip focused mostly on history and culture?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is designed for travelers who want to explore Morocco’s imperial cities, Roman history, and artisan traditions without spending long days driving to the Sahara.

faqs.question: Can we return to Casablanca on Day 5 instead of flying out of Fes?
faqs.answer: Yes. On Day 5, your driver can take you straight back to Casablanca city or Mohammed V Airport via the highway (roughly 3.5 hours).

faqs.question: How much time do we get in Chefchaouen?
faqs.answer: You arrive in the afternoon on Day 2 and stay overnight, giving you both the quiet evening hours and the peaceful early morning before day-trip buses arrive.

faqs.question: Is a local guide included for Fes?
faqs.answer: Yes. A licensed local guide leads your walking tour through Fes el-Bali, covering the madrasas, university, tanneries, and historic markets.

faqs.question: Are airport pick-ups and drop-offs included?
faqs.answer: Yes. We pick you up at Casablanca Airport (CMN) or your hotel on Day 1, and drop you off at either Fes Airport (FEZ) or Casablanca Airport on Day 5.
